q.q: Which SQL statement is used to remove an entire table (structure and data)?
q.x: DROP TABLE deletes the table structure and all its data. DELETE removes rows only, keeping the table.

q.q: Which SQL clause eliminates duplicate rows from a result set?
q.x: SELECT DISTINCT returns only unique values. UNIQUE is a constraint, and GROUP BY groups rows.

q.q: Which SQL aggregate function returns the highest value in a column?
q.x: MAX() is the standard aggregate for the maximum value. There is no TOP()/LARGEST() aggregate function.

q.q: Which JOIN returns all rows from the left table and the matching rows from the right table (with NULLs where no match exists)?
q.x: LEFT OUTER JOIN keeps every row of the left table, filling unmatched right-side columns with NULL.
